notes.title: Small update: Boundary++ Max Segment Length
notes.notes: This update introduces a maximum Boundary++ segment length. Larger boundaries are split into several segments. This improves the visual quality of the boundary when used with (very) large play areas.

notes.title: Stop Sign VR update: Recenter fix and active box side indicator
notes.notes:
The “[i]reset standing position[/i]” button on the SteamVR dashboard allows users to adjust standing position and orientation for the current SteamVR session. Unfortunately, it also caused a displacement of [i]StopSignVR[/i]'s boxes. This update fixes that and keeps the boxes in place during and after a “[i]standing position reset[/i]”.

This update also introduces a small feature: When editing the size and position of boxes it will visually indicate the closest side, which is the side you will pull on when resizing.

Any questions or ideas? Please reach out!

notes.title: Update: Heads-Up Display (HUD) and dashboard settings UI
notes.notes:
Today's update introduces a few new features:

[list]
[*][i]Stop Sign VR[/i] now includes a [b]Heads-Up Display (HUD)[/b] showing a vignette in your peripheral vision when a proximity warning or predicted impact occurs out of view. You will get a visual alert even when the object or wall boundary is to your side or behind you.
[*]The main features of the app can now be turned on and off using the [b]dashboard in VR[/b]. Changes happen instantly. More detailed configuration options are still accessible using the [i]Settings Editor[/i] in the Windows System Tray.
[*]For ceiling protection it uses the ceiling height as defined by the chaperone height in SteamVR Settings.
[*]There's an extra setting per box called [i]"Ignore Headset Distance For Fade In"[/i]. It's useful for play areas with low ceilings where you want to protect e.g. a ceiling light but you don't want the box to show up when you're standing under it. The controllers still trigger the fade-in and the headset still triggers impact alerts and proximity warnings.
[/list]

All comments, new ideas and other feedback welcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290799/2b596eb1b925d6cd94079b3091af4e2b25d02614.png[/img]
